method: Inspect 8 original branch files via GitHub source, compare literal journal lines with reported original binary/source receipt and incident narrative. Dates before crash only where provided. SHA fields are Git blob identifiers from connector; original benchmark and module SHA-256 sourced from existing receipts, not recalculated here.
